info.title: FIXO API
info.description: Home-services marketplace API. Every error uses the ErrorBody shape; clients switch on error.code (stable), never on error.message. Send X-Request-Id (UUID) to correlate logs.

tags.name: admin-auth
tags.description: Admin web login: email + password, then mandatory TOTP MFA. The refresh token is an httpOnly cookie; refresh and logout need X-CSRF-Token equal to the fixo_csrf cookie.

200.description: API, database and Redis are up

503.description: A dependency is down (see details). error.code: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE

post.summary: Send a login OTP by SMS
post.description: Same response whether or not the number has an account. In development the code is printed in the jobs process output (FakeSms).

parameters.name: X-Device-Id
parameters.description: App-generated install id (UUID); enables the per-device limit

400.description: Body or header failed validation. error.code: VALIDATION_FAILED

429.description: Too many requests; also sent as the Retry-After header. error.code: RATE_LIMITED

post.summary: Verify the OTP and log in (creates the account on first login)
post.description: Returns the session tokens. Send the access token as "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

parameters.name: X-Device-Id
parameters.description: App-generated install id (UUID). The session is bound to it.

400.description: Body or header failed validation. error.code: VALIDATION_FAILED

401.description: Wrong, expired, used or locked code. error.code: OTP_INVALID

403.description: Account suspended or blocked. error.code: ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED

post.summary: Exchange the refresh token for a new token pair
post.description: Refresh tokens are single use. Never run two refreshes in parallel: presenting a token twice is treated as theft and ends the session.

parameters.name: X-Device-Id
parameters.description: App-generated install id (UUID). The session is bound to it.

400.description: Body or header failed validation. error.code: VALIDATION_FAILED

401.description: Session expired, revoked, reused or wrong device: log in again. error.code: SESSION_EXPIRED

403.description: Account suspended or blocked. error.code: ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED

post.summary: End the session (works even with an expired access token)

400.description: Body or header failed validation. error.code: VALIDATION_FAILED

post.description: Returns a 5-minute mfaToken. On first login (stage "enroll") it also returns a TOTP secret and otpauth URL to add to an authenticator app.

400.description: Body or header failed validation. error.code: VALIDATION_FAILED

401.description: Wrong email or password, or account locked (same answer for all). error.code: INVALID_CREDENTIALS

403.description: Account suspended or blocked. error.code: ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED

post.summary: Step 2: TOTP code; starts the session
post.description: Sets the fixo_admin_rt and fixo_admin_device (httpOnly) and fixo_csrf cookies. Keep the access token in memory only.

400.description: Body or header failed validation. error.code: VALIDATION_FAILED

401.description: Wrong or replayed code, too many attempts, or expired mfaToken. error.code: MFA_INVALID

403.description: Account suspended or blocked. error.code: ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED

post.summary: New access token from the refresh cookie (rotates the cookie)

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Must equal the fixo_csrf cookie (double-submit CSRF protection)

401.description: Session expired: log in again. error.code: SESSION_EXPIRED

403.description: CSRF check failed, or account restricted. error.code: CSRF_FAILED, ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED

post.summary: End the admin session and clear its cookies

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Must equal the fixo_csrf cookie (double-submit CSRF protection)

get.summary: List config versions (newest first), e.g. ?status=pending for approvals

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token: refresh it. error.code: UNAUTHENTICATED

403.description: Role not allowed, or account restricted. error.code: FORBIDDEN, ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED

post.summary: Propose a new version of a config value
post.description: Per key: revenue.* and auth.* only super admin; others super admin or operations. Keys needing approval (revenue) stay pending until a finance admin approves.

400.description: Invalid body, unknown key, or value fails the key schema. error.code: VALIDATION_FAILED, CONFIG_KEY_UNKNOWN

403.description: Role not allowed, or account restricted. error.code: FORBIDDEN, ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED

409.description: Overlaps an already scheduled version. error.code: CONFIG_OVERLAP

post.summary: Approve a pending version (a different admin than the proposer)

403.description: Role not allowed, or the proposer approving their own change. error.code: FORBIDDEN, MAKER_CANNOT_APPROVE

409.description: Not pending, or overlaps a scheduled version. error.code: CONFIG_NOT_PENDING, CONFIG_OVERLAP
